parts.name: Root
parts.description: The checkbox control. Renders a span with role="checkbox" and keeps a hidden checkbox input in sync for form integration.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the hidden input so `label[for]` can target the checkbox. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: name
props.description: Name submitted with the form when the checkbox is checked.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when the checkbox is checked. Does not affect the visual state.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Controlled indeterminate (mixed) state. Bindable. Takes precedence over `checked`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user changes the checked state.

props.name: onIndeterminateChange
props.description: Called when the indeterminate state changes through user interaction. The first toggle from indeterminate resolves to checked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes the checkbox from interaction and focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the checkbox focusable while preventing state changes.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the hidden input as required for form validation.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label when no visible label is associated.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the checkbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden native input.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate (mixed).

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed via pointer or keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked.

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: The visual check or mixed mark. Only mounted while the checkbox is checked or indeterminate unless `forceMount` is set.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM even while the checkbox is unchecked.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the indicator, typically an icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate (mixed).

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed via pointer or keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked.
